content: Hi! Let me know how I can help with your recent invoice or payment questions, just flag anything urgent and I'll prioritize it.
I noticed my last invoice for project 039B wasn't marked as paid in my PayPal summary. Can you double-check if the funds came through?

Absolutely, I'll review that for you right away. Your PayPal payment for Invoice #039B, amounting to $1,460.50, shows as completed on May 31st, with transaction ID 5RV69912YZ856443R. Have you checked the account linked to your email, dylan.freelance22@gmail.com?
Thanks. That's my email, yes. I don't see the deposit in my linked Chase account ending 1842. Should I expect a delay?

Understood, sometimes PayPal transfers to bank accounts (like your Chase 1842) can take up to 24 hours, especially over weekends. Since the payment cleared Friday at 4:17 PM, it may process by Monday morning.
That's helpful. My client, Lena Martinez, usually pays instantly, so I just want to be sure nothing's off.

Rest assured, Lena's payment from her PayPal handle @lena.martinez was fully processed. For your records, the reference code is FREELANCE-MAY23-LM. If you haven't received the funds by noon tomorrow, let me know and I'll escalate it.
Can you confirm the invoice number and amount again, just in case I need to reference it in a client follow-up?

Certainly! The invoice in question is #039B, billed at $1,460.50, paid to your PayPal (dylan.freelance22@gmail.com) on May 31st. Keep the transaction ID 5RV69912YZ856443R handy for any future correspondence, acting quickly will help if any issues arise.
